name: Airplane Attack Simulator
desc:
- How to play:

- Shoot airplanes to get iron ✈️
- Sell iron for money 💰
- Buy better guns with money 🔫
- Upgrade your backpack storage to hold more iron! 📦
- Buy pets to help out with your adventure! 🐶

- Join our group to know exactly when we update! 📝

- made by Infernal Game Development! 🔥
